verdict.rationale: Missive is an email client and shared inbox, so aliases or masked addresses are a fair axis to ask about. The evidence pack never documents creating aliases, masked or forwarding addresses, or hiding a user's real address from sign-ups or strangers. The only use of "alias" refers to a legacy API field name, which is unrelated.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
